details.releaseNotesExcerpt: <details open> sycl: fix CONV_2D wrong results for non-contiguous input (#30363) * sycl: fix CONV_2D wrong results for non-contiguous input The kernel indexes the `input` as a contiguous [W, H, C, N] tensor, but supports_op claimed the op for any layout. A non-contiguous (e.g. `CWHN` permuted) input was read with the wrong element offsets, silently producing wrong results. Gate the CONV_2D op on `input` and `kernel` contiguity, matching the CUDA backend contract, and assert input contiguity in the op. `test-backend-ops -b SYCL0 -o CONV_2D`: goes from 16 failures to 0, none. ```text 2006/2006 tests passed Backend SYCL0: OK Backend 2/2: CPU Skipping 2/2 backends passed OK ``` Assisted-by: pi (unsloth/Qwen3.8-27B-GGUF:Q4_K_M via llama.cpp) * sycl : CONV_2D cwhn=1 support Make the SYCL backend compute `GGML_OP_CONV_2D` correctly for `cwhn=1` (CWHN channel-order) inputs and kernels, so the previously failing test- backend-ops CONV_2D cases pass on SYCL instead of being skipped or miscompute

It targets speculative decoding verification (2 to 8 tokens per step) and short prompt batches (9 to 80 tokens). Three types also use it for a single column (Q2_K, Q3_K, Q8_0). * Fixed regression bug real bug found: the first version produced NaN whenever the row count wasn't a multiple of 4 * Removed GGML_TYPE_Q8_0 activation * rewritten xmx_mul_mat 64-byte alignment and 16-byte pitch check on the activations * Implemented fused gate/up kernel One launch computes up * act(gate) for both FFN weights, reading the activations once and applying SWIGLU or GEGLU in the epilogue. details.releaseNotesExcerpt: <details open> model : fix qwen4exp layer inputs for DFlash drafters (#30927) qwen4exp published the hc-wide residual [n_embd, hc, n_tokens] as t_layer_inp, but the drafter reads layer inputs as [n_embd, n_tokens] rows: llama_context sizes each embd_layer_inp buffer as n_embd * n_batch and the DFlash encoder input is n_extract * n_embd wide. Evaluating a DFlash draft over a qwen4exp target therefore aborts on the first request in llama_context::extract_layer_inputs. Collapse the streams with a plain mean before exposing them, as deepseek4 already does for its hyper-connection residual, and build the mean only for the layers a drafter actually requested. Assisted-by: pi:llama.cpp/ggml-org/Qwen3.8-Flash-Next-GGUF (MacBook, M5 Max, 128GB) </details> **Website:** - <https://llama.app> **Attestations:** - <https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/attestations/58746321> **macOS/iOS:** - [macOS Apple Silicon (arm64)](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/releases/download/b11822/llama-b11822-bin

details.releaseNotesExcerpt: <details open> server: realtime API: send complete after committed audio drains (#30994) * server: realtime API: send complete after committed audio drains * server: realtime API: complete a commit at its end row Completion is triggered when the stream runs dry, which is a timing proxy: audio appended while the tail drains leaks into the committed item, a final commit before the drain merges both items, and back to back commits collapse into one. mtmd_audio_stream_flush() records the row count at the end of the flushed audio (mtmd_audio_stream_get_n_rows_flushed), next to the rows produced so far (mtmd_audio_stream_get_n_rows).
